#### HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE  APARESH KUMAR SINGH

### HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE APARESH KUMAR SINGH

Born on 7th July, 1965. His Lordship passed B.A. Honours and obtained L.L.B. Degree from University of Delhi.
On transfer took oath as the Hon’ble Chief Justice of the High Court for the State of Telangana on 19th July, 2025.
